mapper.select: SELECT ip, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM t_link_access_log_stats WHERE full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time <= DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) -- 优化：强制热数据，只查30天内（可修改7/15天） AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND ip != 'unknown' AND ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ip ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ip, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM t_link_access_log_stats WHERE
full_short_url IN
#{url}
AND 1=0
-- 优化2：修复索引失效 AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time <= DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) -- 优化3：强制热数据 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND ip != 'unknown' AND ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ip ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pre.ip IS NULL THEN cur.ip END) AS newUserCnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pre.ip IS NOT NULL THEN cur.ip END) AS oldUserCnt FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ip FROM t_link_access_log_stats WHERE
full_short_url IN
#{url}
1=0
AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time <= DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) cur LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ip FROM t_link_access_log_stats WHERE
full_short_url IN
#{url}
1=0
AND create_time < #{start} ) pre ON cur.ip = pre.ip
